text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it!!
Why... Why couldn't I grasp it...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Orfe! You're number one!
Show us your glorious comeback next time!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Of course.
Of course, I shall not forgive this...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"This humiliation...!
I shall surely avenge it with radiant brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh.
...Even though she lost, the crowd's cheering so loud...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation!
Great work out there!! Nice run!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to next time!
Thanks for showing us such a great race!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
Please watch me... next time too!!

She wasn't able to claim victory at the Nippon Derby—
but the cheers embracing Win Variation
were warm and gentle.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It didn't work out. ...But,
there were people who were watching me, too."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It's definitely reaching them.
I know I'm getting closer."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(If I just keep working hard and moving forward
together with Trainer like this—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Someday, I might surpass Orfevre
and become the leading star... maybe.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...! I have to try my best.
More and more, even more...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together in our next target race, the Kikuka Sho, too!
I'm counting on you...!

Next was the Kikuka Sho, the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
Days of rushing toward the big autumn stage had begun.
